subject: Sparrow AI — post-call summary, stakeholders & proposed milestones
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@sparrow.ai>, Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@sparrow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Sparrow AI — post-call summary, stakeholders & proposed milestones

Hi Julia / Ethan —

Thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed mutual action plan so we keep momentum. I focused this on the items we agreed matter most for your pilot and the internal owners we heard on the call.

Key pain / goals you shared
- Inference cost and latency spikes during peak (user-facing chatbot) — current infra not predictable
- Need deterministic rollout path from PoC to production (artifact versioning, canary)
- Data isolation + audit logging for compliance (SOC2 scope)

Pilot success criteria (what we discussed)
1) End-to-end 99th percentile latency <= 500ms for 95% of chat sessions
2) Per-token compute cost reduction >= 30% vs current baseline during steady-state
3) Audit logs and KMS integration validated for one regulatory workflow

Proposed mutual milestones (draft dates included) — full spreadsheet attached (sparrow-mvp-milestones.xlsx):
- Week 0 (by 2024-04-18): Environment access + sample dataset + baseline measurements (Owner: Carlos Ruiz, Sparrow)
- Week 2 (by 2024-05-02): Initial hosted pilot with Redwood API (smaller model) + latency baseline (Owner: Hannah Schmitt, Redwood)
- Week 6 (by 2024-05-30): Validation of batching/quantization profile and cost report (Owner: Ben Carter, Redwood)
- Week 10 (by 2024-06-27): KMS integration & audit log verification (Owner: Monica Patel, Redwood)
- Decision checkpoint (by 2024-07-05): Internal Sparrow exec review + go/no-go for Dedicated capacity

Next steps I propose now
1) Hannah to send the milestones spreadsheet and an initial SOW sketch for pilot scope — attached.
2) Sparrow to share service account and a small (anonymized) sample of traffic and baseline metrics by 2024-04-18.
3) Quick pricing ballpark (Hannah/Ben) by 2024-04-15 for the pilot envelope — we can refine after baseline numbers.

Open questions we flagged
- Are there any internal procurement constraints that would require an MSP or marketplace purchase instead of direct contract? (Julia/Carlos)
- Who will be Sparrow’s decision approver at the July checkpoint? We heard product lead + security — please confirm exact names.

Attached: sparrow-mvp-milestones.xlsx; redwood-term-clarifying-questions.pdf

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the spreadsheet and a short SOW draft by COB Monday (2024-04-15).

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2024 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sparrow AI — post-call summary, stakeholders & proposed milestones

Thanks Hannah — this is very clear and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement: we prefer direct contracting but procurement needs a < $10k T&Cs redline window; anything above that we route via our procurement partner (marketplace possible). Will confirm exact process early next week.
2) Decision approver: Product Lead (Talia Chen) + Security (Markus Lehman). Talia will lead the success criteria review.
3) Baseline metrics: we can deliver a 72-hour sample and traffic capture by 2024-04-17. Carlos will own that.

On pricing — can you provide a pilot ballpark by Monday? We want to make sure we can present it to Talia in the decision checkpoint.

Also I noticed you recommended a smaller open model for the first pilot. Can you confirm which model version you intend to use (and approximate instance types)?

Appreciate it — Julia

Julia Park
Director of Product, Sparrow AI
julia.park@sparrow.ai

Julia —

Attached is the milestones workbook and a short SOW sketch (see attachments). For the pilot we recommend starting with the Redwood-curated 7B quantized profile (rlm7b-q4) on a 1xA100 equivalent in hosted mode to validate latency/cost tradeoffs. If latency looks good we can test a 2x A100 Dedicated pool for production throughput.

High-level pilot ballpark (initial, subject to baseline):
- Pilot setup + 4-week execution + reporting: $18,000 (one-time pilot fee)
- Monthly hosted usage estimate (based on your sample): $6,500/mo

We’ll add line items in the SOW for KMS/audit support and an optional Dedicated pricing appendix. Ben — can you confirm Dedicated pool ballpark?

Hannah

Attachments: sparrow-mvp-milestones.xlsx; redwood-term-clarifying-questions.pdf
